jurisdiction.venue: U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York

headline: Firm Named ‘Backward Hat Capital’ Accused of Operating $600 Million Currency Ponzi Scheme
deck: Federal prosecutors in Manhattan allege Phillip Williams and Devin Johnson solicited more than 2,000 retail investors with promises of over 6 percent monthly foreign-exchange returns.
byline: By The Financial Crimes Courts Desk

live_updates.text: SDNY prosecutors unseal indictment charging Backward Hat Capital principals Phillip Williams and Devin Johnson over alleged $600M forex pool.
Filing notes promised returns exceeding 6% per month (>100% annualized) drew over 2,000 retail accounts before redemptions stalled.
Defendants retain presumption of innocence pending arraignment and bail proceedings in Manhattan federal court.

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: Criminal fraud charges pending in SDNY over ~$600M allegedly solicited from 2,000+ retail investors.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: Retail check-kiting scheme totaling $2,400 at a neighborhood branch
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Immediate pre-trial detention without unsecured personal recognizance bond
